records.text: Ben Shapiro staffs audiences with people who work for YAF who are told to explode into cheers when he hits the stage
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: You staff audiences. with people that work for YAF who are told to explode into cheers when you hit the stage because you don't have the confidence anymore to go out into the world because you know people see you for what you are.

verification.notes: Transcript context confirms that Candace Owens directly accused Ben Shapiro of staffing audiences with YAF workers instructed to cheer. Live searches for the exact allegation and review of YAF's public Shapiro-tour material found documentation of YAF's sponsorship, event logistics, student-controlled ticket lists, and public attendance, but no independent evidence establishing that YAF employees were planted in audiences or instructed to cheer. The original episode documents that the accusation was made, not that the alleged conduct occurred. No source directly contradicts the allegation, so absence of corroboration is treated as attempted/unverifiable rather than false.

records.text: Owens accused Young America’s Foundation of paying people to attend the Turning Point USA tour and pretend that its organizers had taken over the youth movement.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: They just lie. I think, when Tucker Carlson is not slated to speak and Ben Shapiro is, there's something so sick about it. But it's now laughably sick, where you can just go, 'Okay, this is all fake.' The whole thing is you're going to get a bunch of YAF people to come in, pay them to come hear him speak, and pretend like you've taken over the youth movement. I mean, you should just laugh at it, and in that regard, we already won. Again, not referencing everybody who's on that list.
